description: A set of prose primitives — headings, paragraph, lead, blockquote, list and inline code — with consistent rhythm. Use them for article and documentation body copy.
docs: Named exports: H1, H2, H3, H4, P, Lead, Large, Blockquote, List, InlineCode. Plain semantic elements with spacing baked in, so they compose with MDX without extra wrappers.
